name: Table Mountain Fund annual call for concept proposals

funder.name: The Table Mountain Fund (WWF South Africa)

summary: Annual call for registered South African organisations running community conservation, education and advocacy projects in the Cape Floristic Region, under the Pride and Care programmes. Grants run up to three years.

amount.note: For up to three years; small grants of up to R100,000 for one year

status.quote: The 2026 Call for Proposals is now closed.
The 2027 Call for Proposals will open in early 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Registered organisations in good standing, working in environmental education, community conservation or advocacy within the Cape Floristic Region, are encouraged to apply. In exceptional cases, well-motivated organisations not yet registered as NPOs may be considered.

geography.quote: Registered organisations in good standing, working in environmental education, community conservation or advocacy within the Cape Floristic Region, are encouraged to apply. In exceptional cases, well-motivated organisations not yet registered as NPOs may be considered.

access.quote: Please note that TMF does not entertain unsolicited grant applications outside of these annual calls.

window.quote: TMF issues an annual call for concept notes which is usually circulated in the first quarter of the year.

amount.quote: Up to R250 000 per year for a maximum of three years (R750 000 total); Small grants of up to R100 000 for one year.
